plain probe through CLIProxyAPI pinned to the Codex login (temporary alias probe/gpt-6-astra). Hit 2 of 3 at 2.5 minutes and 3 of 3 at 5 minutes, then misses at some later ages (1 of 3 at 30 min, 1 h and 2 h). The published 0 means that there is no tested age through which every check hit, not that this route does not cache. Earlier runs of this route started at 5 minutes, or were made by another client (pi, low reasoning, larger prompts), so this is a first look at 2.5 minutes with plain requests, not a comparison that shows a change. Three window requests of 921,500 tokens went to the same login one to two minutes before the priming, and the owner's own sessions use the login. Early misses also occurred without a large request before the priming and without two models priming at once: GS1 and GA1 (logins-gpt-6-2-2026-11-17, GPT-6.2 Sol and Astra, the same evening) each missed 1 of 3 at 2.5 minutes. That does not rule out every kind of load, and it says nothing certain about the cause of this run's misses, which is not established. The missing session_id is not the cause: CLIProxyAPI copies prompt_cache_key into the upstream session id.
